name: Medical AI & Clinical Informatics
description: Citation network of landmark breakthroughs in biomedical NLP, protein folding, and clinical diagnostics.

nodes.title: Highly Accurate Protein Structure Prediction with AlphaFold
nodes.abstract: We present AlphaFold, a computational method capable of predicting 3D protein structures with atomic accuracy directly from primary amino acid sequences, solving a 50-year-old grand challenge in biology.

nodes.title: BioBERT: A Pre-trained Biomedical Language Representation Model
nodes.abstract: BioBERT is a domain-specific language model pre-trained on large biomedical corpora from PubMed abstracts and PMC articles, outperforming standard BERT on biomedical named entity recognition and relation extraction.

nodes.title: Med-PaLM: Towards Expert-Level Medical Question Answering
nodes.abstract: We evaluate large language models on medical licensing question benchmarks. Med-PaLM leverages instruction tuning and expert clinical consensus alignment to achieve expert-level diagnostic question-answering accuracy.

nodes.title: ClinicalBERT: Modeling Clinical Notes and Hospital Readmission
nodes.abstract: We adapt deep language representations to clinical healthcare notes from intensive care records, accurately predicting 30-day patient hospital readmissions and clinical risk trajectories.

nodes.title: CheXNet: Radiologist-Level Pneumonia Detection on Chest X-Rays
nodes.abstract: CheXNet is a 121-layer dense convolutional neural network trained on over 100,000 frontal chest X-ray images, exceeding the average performance of board-certified radiologists in detecting pneumonia.

nodes.title: Deep Learning for Classification of Skin Cancer
nodes.abstract: We demonstrate classification of skin lesions using a single deep neural network trained directly from clinical photographic images, matching dermatologist performance across both keratinocyte and melanoma biopsies.

nodes.title: PubMedBERT: Domain-Specific Pretraining for Biomedical NLP
nodes.abstract: We show that domain-specific pre-training from scratch using biomedical text alone outperforms continuous pre-training of general-domain checkpoints on specialized biomedical benchmarks.

nodes.title: MIMIC-III: A Freely Accessible Critical Care Database
nodes.abstract: MIMIC-III integrates comprehensive, de-identified clinical data from over 40,000 intensive care patients, serving as the benchmark standard for clinical machine learning and diagnostic predictive modeling.
